# opentags

> Accurate tracking. Built for robotics. Our mission: Make accurate tracking accessible to people building robots. U1 is our current UWB development platform; U2 and S1 are in development. Product claims must be read with their validation status.

Key facts:

- Product: opentag U1, a UWB distance and indoor location tag in a PETG enclosure with clear lid
- Kits: U1 Distance Kit (2 tags, $199) gives live point-to-point distance; U1 Location Kit (5 tags, $499) provides indoor location hardware with 4 fixed anchors plus 1 mobile tag
- Engineering targets pending ground-truthed validation: ±10 cm TWR ranging accuracy, ±20 cm TDOA position accuracy, 50 Hz update rate, 60 m line-of-sight range
- Measured TWR, October 2026 (one U1 PCB V2 pair, website twr-5 firmware, indoor line of sight): over one hour at 4.28 m the mean error was −0.3 cm with a 2.1 cm standard deviation; 12 of 14 one-minute runs from 0.57 m to 5.66 m averaged within ±10 cm. Details and raw data: https://open-tags.com/validation/
- Interfaces: USB-C serial stream, CAN and CAN FD; powered over USB-C or a 6–24V input with reverse-polarity protection
- MCU: STM32 Cortex-M4 at 170 MHz, 256K flash, 128K RAM; radio: Qorvo DWM3000
- Firmware: Rust (Embassy framework); prebuilt roles can be flashed and their serial output monitored in the browser via WebUSB / Web Serial, with no local toolchain. Building the current firmware requires a supplied source checkout; no current public source release is linked.
- Available files: mechanical CAD (STEP) for the full assembly, case, and lid; prebuilt role binaries; Python distance tools; ROS 2 driver and message source packages under Apache-2.0. Schematics, PCB design and fabrication files, firmware source, and enclosure CAD are open source under the MIT License at https://github.com/open-tags/opentag-U1.
- Use cases: indoor robot navigation, drone flight without a motion-capture rig, docking and follow-me between machines, UWB anchor network bring-up, asset-tracking prototypes, RF field testing
- Integration: parse live TWR distance and TDOA position from USB serial; ROS 2 publishes range, position, events, and diagnostics
- Availability: ships in about 1 week from San Diego, CA, USA
- Policies: 30-day returns, 1-year limited warranty; sold as a development kit for evaluation (not certified as a finished consumer product)
- Contact: hello@open-tags.com

## Coming Soon

- U2: planned UWB platform with an IMU and OWM3000 module with separate clock and sync ports. Sensor-fusion scope and S1 compatibility remain to be validated.
- S1 (Sync 1): clock and synchronization distribution intended for U2; compatibility remains in development.
- U2 and S1 are not available to order. Specifications and release dates are not finalized.

## Glossary

- TWR (two-way ranging): one tag pings, the other replies; distance is computed from round-trip time
- TDOA (time-difference of arrival): one mobile tag pings, multiple fixed anchors listen; 3D position is computed from arrival-time deltas
- UWB (ultra-wideband): short-pulse radio that timestamps signal arrival precisely, used for ranging and positioning; performance depends on the implementation and environment
